## ⭐ Duplicate fold — objectstack-ai/objectstack#19366 is the same finding and its evidence is carried here

SKILL.md: 「同文件同缺陷 = 同一发现,不分车道:证据搬到先卡,后卡关 `duplicate_of`,⛔ 不并排派发」. #19366 reports the identical defect — `.claude/skills/spec-property-retirement/SKILL.md:291` prescribing a `major` changeset that the tree refuses. This card is the 先卡 (filed 2026-09-20T13:20Z against #19366's 2026-09-20T13:55Z), so it keeps the carrier and #19366 closes as `duplicate`.

**Three things #19366 established that this card did not, moved here so closing it loses nothing:**

1. **The authority, not just the gate.** This card argues from `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` — a live gate. #19366 names the CONTRACT that supersedes the playbook: `docs/adr/0087-metadata-protocol-upgrade-contract.md:388-402`, 「Amended 2026-09-13 (#18003) — the level half」, landed by PR #18027: 「Pre-GA, a metadata-facing retirement or break ships `minor`, carrying the `**BREAKING**` banner and its ADR-0087 disposition entry. The level is *not* the carrier of breaking-ness during the window … An npm `major` is a planned act … ⛔ never a side effect of one retirement card」. ⇒ the fix is ⛔ not 「write `minor` while the launch-window guard stands」 (this card's wording, which reads as temporary); it is 「`minor` is what the amended contract says a retirement ships」.

2. **A SECOND defect in the same playbook.** The same amendment's third bullet — 「A tombstone names the npm release it ships in, ⛔ never the protocol major」 — is also absent from the playbook. The live convention (`metrics.zod.ts`, `tracing.zod.ts`, followed by PR #19363) is a tombstone reading `@objectstack/spec 17.5.0` while the migration entries are numbered at protocol 18; those two numbers are deliberately different and the playbook says so nowhere. ⇒ the fix is **two lines**, not one.

3. **The measured cost, which is the case for grading it above a doc nit.** Card #17385's half 2 was parked 2026-09-12 on this exact fork; the amendment landed 2026-09-13; the director's class-one adjudication on #18064 closed 2026-09-14 recording 「Ruling ② (#16885 item 5, `major`) is superseded by that text; ruling ① (#16929, `minor`) stands」 — and nothing pointed the parked card at either, so it sat until 2026-09-20 when a seat re-derived the chain by hand. **Eight days, one lane, one fork.** #19366 also carries its own controls on the reading (`changeset` occurs 8 times in the playbook — lit; a fabricated word 0 times — dark).

⚠️ For the lane when it grades: this card's own 「class (a) 示例照抄即失败」 framing and #19366's 「class (b) 违背已声明契约」 framing are both true of the same line and are ⛔ not in conflict — the playbook is a checklist an agent executes verbatim AND it contradicts a declared contract. Grade it once, against whichever class carries the higher disposition.
